Do not drive while taking.","sources":["p1:L6","term:PO","term:q4h","term:PRN"]},{"id":"b3","text":"Tylenol 1,000 mg swallow it every 8 hours scheduled for 2 weeks.","sources":["p1:L7","term:PO","term:q8h"]},{"id":"b4","text":"Enoxaparin 40 mg a shot just under the skin once daily for 14 days to prevent blood clots.","sources":["p1:L8","term:subQ"]},{"id":"b5","text":"Docusate 100 mg swallow it two times a day while taking oxycodone.","sources":["p1:L9","term:PO","term:BID"]},{"id":"b6","text":"Ondansetron 4 mg swallow it every 8 hours only when you need it for nausea.","sources":["p1:L10","term:PO","term:q8h","term:PRN"]}]},{"title":"What to do at home","bullets":[{"id":"b7","text":"You can put weight on your leg if it feels okay with a walker. No tub baths or swimming until staples are removed.","sources":["p1:L12"]},{"id":"b9","text":"Do not drive while taking oxycodone.","sources":["p1:L6"]}]},{"title":"Your follow-up visits","bullets":[{"id":"b10","text":"See the bone doctor in 2 weeks.
